{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check if the QA rows are marked as completed and converted
qa_rows = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99']

# Confirm that all QA rows have status='completed' and converted=1
all_completed = (qa_rows['status'] == 'completed').all()
all_converted = (qa_rows['converted'] == 1).all()

all_completed, all_converted"}
